title: NFL Preseason: Lions Beat Colts in Action-Packed Game
seoTitle: Lions Defeat Colts in Preseason Showdown
subtitle: The hunt for where to watch NFL games intensifies with the 2026 preseason underway, spotlighting the clash between the Detroit Lions and Indianapolis Colts.
excerpt: The 2026 NFL preseason is in full swing, sparking fan interest in following each matchup.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The 2026 NFL preseason is in full swing, and fan interest in following the games is remarkable. The recent clash between the Detroit Lions and Indianapolis Colts in Week 3 of the preseason illustrates the excitement surrounding the league and the quest for platforms to follow every play.

The NFL Preseason Spotlight

The 2026 NFL preseason continues as teams chase crucial victories on their road to Super Bowl LXI. Both the Lions and the Colts, for example, are among the teams vying for championships in their respective conferences, making each game a key step toward their goals.

Detroit Lions vs. Indianapolis Colts on the Field

In Week 3 of the 2026 NFL preseason, the Detroit Lions and Indianapolis Colts faced off at Lucas Oil Stadium. The game was marked by high anticipation, with both teams seeking a win to maintain momentum and advance their seasonal aspirations. At the end of the matchup, the Detroit Lions secured a 25-16 victory over the Indianapolis Colts.

Highlights of the Matchup

The Lions vs. Colts game featured moments of intense play and decisive moves. On the Colts side, quarterback Anthony Richardson Sr. led two drives that resulted in points, with Blake Grupe converting 46- and 36-yard field goals. Freshman running back DJ Giddens scored a six-yard touchdown, and kicker Spencer Shrader showcased his strength with a 60-yard field goal in the third quarter.

The Colts’ defense, especially the rookies, stood out by forcing four turnovers. All-Pro cornerback Sauce Gardner kicked off the series with an interception, while linebackers Bryce Boettcher and CJ Allen forced fumbles recovered by defensive ends Caden Curry and Mitchell Melton, respectively. George Gumbs Jr. also contributed with a strip-sack.

Meanwhile, the Lions saw Tay Martin catch an eight-yard pass for a touchdown, giving the team the lead at halftime. Jackson Meeks also scored a touchdown on a 16-yard pass. Jared Goff led the visitors’ offense on several drives, and Trayveon Williams contributed six-yard rushing touchdowns, showcasing the team’s offensive power.

Where to Follow the Games

For fans interested in following the action of the NFL preseason, the coverage of the Detroit Lions vs. Indianapolis Colts game was provided by VAVEL.com. The platform streamed all plays of the matchup, allowing viewers to follow the unfolding of Week 3 of the 2026 preseason and the teams’ preparations for the regular season.

Road to Super Bowl LXI

The Detroit Lions start a new season in the AFC after finishing seventh in their conference, securing a playoff berth but being halted by injuries. The team is rebuilding, focusing on the offense led by Jared Goff and players like Isaiah Pacheco, Tarik Black, Sam LaPorta, Cade Mays, and Blake Miller. The aspiration is to repeat the playoff appearance and reach the conference final.

The Indianapolis Colts also continue their AFC season, seeking to recover from a disappointing 2025 campaign, in which they missed the playoffs with a 7-10 record. The team’s challenge is rebuilding, with a focus on reshaping the offense to provide better options for quarterback Daniel Jones. Players such as Jonathan Taylor, George Pickens, Kenneth Murray Jr., Donovan Wilson, CeeDee Lamb, and Brandon Aubrey are key pieces in this project. Offensive chemistry will be crucial to the Colts’ ambitions this season.
